# Invio by Timrio — Full LLM Specification & Documentation

> Complete technical, functional, and architectural documentation of Invio, the 100% free offline desktop invoicing and inventory system.

---

## 1. Overview & Positioning
Invio is a free, privacy-first desktop software for retail shops, traders, consultants, and small business owners. Unlike cloud SaaS invoicing services that require recurring monthly fees and internet connectivity, Invio runs 100% locally on the user's computer.

### Primary Values:
- **Zero Cost**: Completely free with unlimited invoices, products, and customers.
- **True Offline Capability**: Works without an internet connection.
- **Hardware Integration**: Compatible with thermal receipt printers (58mm/80mm), cash drawers, and USB/Bluetooth barcode scanners.
- **Privacy & Ownership**: All data stays stored on the user's local disk in SQLite or their self-hosted PostgreSQL database.

---

## 2. Technical Architecture & Stack
- **Frontend / UI**: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, Vite.
- **Desktop Runtime**: Electron 44, Node.js 22, context isolation, sandboxed main-to-renderer bridge via IPC.
- **Database Engine**: Local SQLite (WAL mode) with fallback/switch support for external PostgreSQL.
- **PDF Engine**: Electron native window PDF renderer with automated thermal & A4 layouts.
- **Offline Barcode / QR Generation**: Native vector-based Matrix QR engine for UPI payments (no external API calls required).

---

## 3. Core Features & Workflows

### GST Tax Calculation Engine
- **Intra-State Transactions**: When seller and customer GSTIN share the same initial 2-digit state code (or for unregistered walk-in customers), tax is split into 50% Central GST (CGST) + 50% State GST (SGST).
- **Inter-State Transactions**: When buyer's GSTIN state code differs from the seller's state code, 100% Integrated GST (IGST) is applied automatically.
- **HSN / SAC Codes**: Line items support dedicated HSN/SAC classification codes for statutory compliance.

### Thermal Receipt & Cash Memo Printing
- **Supported Roll Widths**:
  - `thermal-58`: 58mm (2-inch) standard POS rolls.
  - `thermal-80`: 80mm (3-inch) wide POS rolls.
  - `standard-a4`: Full page standard laser/inkjet formats.
- **Print Elements**: Business branding logo, store contact header, itemized line rates, tax breakdown summary, balance due, return policy note, and Code128 invoice barcode.
- **Dynamic UPI Payment QR**: Generates an offline UPI QR string `upi://pay?pa={upiId}&pn={businessName}&am={amountDue}&cu={currency}` rendered directly on thermal slips.

### Inventory & Stock Management
- **Automatic Stock Adjustments**: Invoice finalization decrements inventory quantities in real-time.
- **Stock Restoration**: Deleting or cancelling an invoice automatically restores product quantities.
- **Low Stock Thresholds**: Configurable `minStock` alert boundaries with dashboard notifications.
- **Hardware Barcode Scanning**: Rapid barcode input automatically matches products and adds billable lines.

---

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Is Invio really free?
Yes. Invio is 100% free with no trial limits, invoice caps, or recurring subscription fees.

### Does Invio require an internet connection?
No. All billing, printing, stock tracking, and receipt generation work offline. Internet is only required if you choose to email invoices via SMTP or check for app updates.

### Where is my data stored?
Data is stored directly on your computer in an SQLite database file (`invio.sqlite`). You can also connect to an external PostgreSQL database in Settings.
